title: Ubutabera mu bacuruzi
intro: Hari umuntu wari uhagaze imbere y’abantu batwawe n’inyungu, abahamagarira kuba inyangamugayo no gukiranuka mu byo bakora. Uyu mugaragu wa Allah yaburiye ko badatanga ibipimo bigufi no gusibanganya iminzani. Abantu banze kumva, batera ubwoba ko bazamwirukana mu gihugu cyabo. Ubutaka ubwabwo bwari kubacira urubanza. Ni nde uyu muntu wahagarariye ubutabera mu bacuruzi?
clues: Natumwe nk'intumwa ku bantu bari buzuye ubucuruzi n'ubucuruzi.
Abantu banjye bapimye ibipimo bigufi mu gihe bapimiraga abandi ibintu.
Banteye ubwoba ko bazanyirukana mu gihugu ninkomeza kubahamagarira kwizera.
Ndibukwa nk'umuntu uvuga neza cyane mu bahanuzi.
Abantu banjye bafashwe n'umutingito ukomeye watumye bapfa mu ngo zabo.
Noherejwe ku baturage ba Madyan mu majyaruguru ya Hijaz.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Baterwa ubwoba no kwirukanwa mu gihugu
Abantu banjye bazajugunywa mu muriro ugurumana
Yahuye n'abapfumu b'umwami ukomeye wa farawo
Yahuye n'igisabo cyo gukora ingamiya y'ingore ivuye mu rutare
Nabonye isenywa ry'umujyi wanjye n'ingabo z'abamarayika
trial.answer: Baterwa ubwoba no kwirukanwa mu gihugu

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Abantu banjye barohamye mu myuzure ikomeye
Abantu banjye batatanyijwe n'umuyaga uvuza induru
Nakijijwe ubwo nari mu nda y'ifi nini

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
